newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha perks up but wet market seen balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha perks up but wet market seen balanced.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices perked up to show small gains on Thursday as crude rallied, but traders said the phsyical market was still well balanced and most support was coming from buying in swaps.
"Physically it is balanced but the swaps look quite strong which is maybe the result of the strong volatility," said one trader.
The Egyptian tender for 1997 closed, traders and contract holders said, and results were awaited sometime in the next three or four days for further direction.
